description: Work out the deadline to answer a data subject or consumer request: EU GDPR and UK GDPR Article 12(3) (one month, extendable by two further months; UK Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 changes), or California CCPA/CPRA (confirm within 10 business days, respond within 45 days with one 45-day extension; opt-out or limit requests within 15 business days). Returns each date with its legal reference, the steps, official sources, last-checked date and page link. Uses GlanceDesk Jurisdiction's tested deadline module.

law.description: eu = EU GDPR, uk = UK GDPR, ccpa = California CCPA/CPRA.

received.description: Local date the request was received, YYYY-MM-DD.

request_type.description: CCPA only (required for ccpa): know = know/access, delete or correct; optout = opt out of sale/sharing, or limit use of sensitive data. Not used for eu or uk.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the person, e.g. "Europe/London", "Asia/Karachi", "America/Los_Angeles". Daylight saving time is applied. Give this or utc_offset; with neither, times are UTC.

utc_offset.description: Fixed offset from UTC instead of time_zone, e.g. "+05:00" or "-04:00" (no daylight-saving changes). Default "+00:00" (UTC).

name: data_request_deadline
title: Data request deadline (GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA)
